ajita shah’s programs
Break free from limitations and step into your extraordinary potential with visionary healer Ajita Shah’s transformational programs. OmniSource

OmniSource
This Bespoke 1:1 is an intimate personalized healing and spiritual counselling experience for the high-achiever looking to grow exponentially in every aspect of life.
This healing is not a one size fits all solution but based on an individual’s comprehensive blueprint helping develop resilience, leadership, capacities for intimacy, self love and life’s accomplishments as desired.
Ajita founded OmniSource, a unique modality which is a tremendous tool to resolve disease and health issues, problems in your business, your bank account, the status of your relationships and much more. It is also a helpful tool for allowing you to manifest your desires.

Conscious Entrepreneur mastery
Being an entrepreneur comes with a roller-coaster ride of highs and lows and is guaranteed to bring you face-to-face with everything that needs to be healed in your life.
Deep-rooted questions of money beliefs, value and self-worth, shame, boundaries, spending and saving patterns, financial and leadership skills, all come to the fore. If you have imbalances in these areas, it will reflect in your success.
Success and leadership begins with you but life has taken it’s toll. You find the stresses of business and life cloud your clarity and judgement. Your confidence is shaky at times but you must maintain a strong image. Your strategies are strong yet the results don’t reflect that wisdom.
Your teams lack the will to win that slows down growth.
In a volatile business environment you know you have what it takes to reach the top but the path seems unclear. Something is holding you back.
Your health is beginning to suffer, as are your relationships. Fatigue is setting in.
It’s time to address all these issues.
The Conscious Entrepreneur Mastery is a high-level 1:1 experience where you unpack in a private and confidential space your deepest thoughts and work with Ajita to identify your hidden blocks that hold you back and work to overcome them. energizing and rebalancing yourself bringing you much needed relief and desired results in your business.
Ready to supercharge your business?

pages.title: About – Ajita Shah
headings: Awaken Humanity to its Divinity in daily life.

Over the past 35+ years, Ajita has helped thousands of individuals — including politicians, athletes, military veterans, media figures, CEOs, and entrepreneurs — experience extraordinary results that conventional methods couldn't deliver. Ajita firmly believes that no matter what challenges you are currently facing healing has an answer.
pages.body_text:
meet Ajita. Ajita is a globally recognized spiritual healer and teacher known for her rare, innate gift to heal. Through her profound ability she blends subtle energy, frequency, quantum principles, visualization, and conscious intention into a powerful and integrated healing and permanent transformative experience.

As the creator of the OmniSource Healing modality, Ajita works beyond conventional methods — tapping directly into each individual's energetic and holographic blueprint. Through this deeply intuitive and holistic approach, she helps clients achieve lasting transformation across the physical, emotional, mental, and spiritual dimensions.

She blends spiritual wisdom, high-level mentorship, and practical strategies, helping her clients embody their highest vision, manifest their soul-aligned businesses, and lead with heart-centered authenticity.

Ajita guides changemakers, entrepreneurs, and leaders awaken to their fullest potential, through deep healing and personal transformation helping them shift from traditional, 3D paradigms of success into higher-frequency living, where abundance flows from inner alignment, purpose, and service to the collective.

Working with her don't just create change — YOU awaken to a new way of seeing, feeling, and living.

THE MISSION: Awaken Humanity to its Divinity in daily life. My mission is to awaken the soul blueprint within all individuals through healing, activating, and upgrading them while amplifying the power of co-creation with source. If ever there was a way to transform a life of quiet desperation into effective peaceful living, healing deep inner wounding surely ranks right up there! - ajita shah

HOW IT ALL BEGAN: Ajita's tryst with spirituality began at age 4. She brings into this life, wisdom and knowledge accumulated from her several past lives as a healer, wizard, hermit, priest and much more. She can access and utilize that ancient wisdom from those lifetimes allowing her to tap into the soul imprint of an individual.

Ajita a natural born healer began playing with energy in her childhood. Initially as a young observer, she would be very empathetic to conversations that transpired between adults, outlining and sharing their issues regarding their health, finances, careers or relationships. Ajita vividly remembers in those early interactions, what can only be described as "automatic intention" which allowed for those obstacles to be eliminated. Later in her teen years she began to more consciously manipulate energy and create undeniable change and relief. With the passage of time, this led to a pronounced growth in Ajita's ability to work energy at will, her intuition and her innate psychic ability. She then amalgamated all that wisdom into a more disciplined and structured modality leading to what she now refers to as "OmniSource".

Her formal education is in Child Development with a post graduation in counselling psychology. Early in her practice Ajita quickly realized that working solely with the mind had its limitations. Her clients weren't experiencing complete transformation — there was a missing link.

This realization led her to pioneer an unconventional, integrative model of recovery and growth: OmniSource Healing (OSH). OSH is a multidimensional intuitive process that works simultaneously across the mind, body, and soul. Drawing on universal principles, human behavior, consciousness and her innate healing abilities, OSH facilitates profound shifts by addressing both surface-level issues and their root causes.

It's a 360° approach — whether someone comes in with a physical ailment, emotional block, or career struggle, the entire energetic ecosystem is addressed. The result: long-lasting healing, clarity, and transformation across all areas of life.

Over the past 35+ years, Ajita has helped thousands of individuals — including politicians, athletes, military veterans, media figures, CEOs, and entrepreneurs — experience extraordinary results that conventional methods couldn't deliver. Ajita firmly believes that no matter what challenges you are currently facing healing has an answer.

CORE VALUES:
1. Integrity — My work involves building relationships and trust – which is impossible without integrity. You can count on me being honest with you and protecting your privacy at all times.
2. Altruism — Your welfare and wellbeing is of utmost importance. My success of over 25 years is based on my sincere desire to help and watch you succeed.
3. Non-Judgmental — Love, not judge is a motto I live by. I will always hold a safe space for you to pour your heart out and heal while bringing you face to face with your current reality so that awareness can help you to transform.
4. Spirituality — Being spiritual lies at the core of following my purpose and being on the path meant for me. It drives me to help you find your 'why'.

G100 / ELLEGOSSSE SECTION: Ajita Shah she takes up the mantel as the G100 ELLEGOSSSE Endorsement Wing, Canada Country Chair. – 100 Recommendations – Universal Principles & Practices – For Gender Equality & Empowerment – Toward Peace, Parity and Prosperity of ALL.

We are pleased to present, 100 recommendations for leaders worldwide, based on our ELLEGOSSSE framework. 10 themes have emerged as key pillars and universal principles for gender equality and empowerment worldwide. These 10 principles further have 10 recommendations each, thus 100 recommendations – comprehensively consolidating the areas of action for cohesive and concerted actions. The acronym ELLEGOSSSE encapsulates these 10 common themes: 1. Education 2. Legislation 3. Leadership 4. Empowerment 5. Governance 6. Ownership 7. Security 8. Sustainability 9. Solidarity 10. Equality.

ELLE refers to woman, and GOSSSE (or GOSSES) to children – indeed our inclusive future is in the hands and hearts of women and children of our one world. And therein also lies the greatest gap that we seek to address through this framework and its recommendations that are universally relevant and applicable.

We present here the ELLEGOSSSE – 100 recommendations from G100 to G20, as also to governments worldwide, including inter-governmental entities and multilateral fora such as across the UN, EU, AU, G7, ASEAN, SAARC, QUAD, as also Universities, Foundations, Corporates, Institutions, Think Tanks, Civil Society, Networks, NGO, International Organizations et al.

The ELLEGOSSSE framework offers 100 actionable recommendations—not as rigid rules, but as a living bouquet of ideas for global communities to adapt, adopt, and act upon in their own contexts. Rooted in shared liberal values of freedom and fairness, it doesn't oppose the old but cultivates the new—inviting everyone to co-create a more equal, empowered world.

ELLEGOSSSE is a people's document: inclusive, cross-cultural, and globally relevant. It provides a common language and purpose across continents, sectors, and identities. Designed to be multimodal, non-partisan, and non-sectarian, it empowers every society to address its unique challenges while honoring its cultural fabric. The framework is flexible—meant to be customized, not imposed—offering tools for individuals and institutions alike to write their own scripts for change, supported by a conscious global network.

It actively expands the circle of changemakers, bringing in new voices and leaders often excluded from gender equality efforts. Whether in homes, schools, corporations, governments, or NGOs, anyone can embed ELLEGOSSSE's principles to drive progress. Its agenda is intersectional, tackling not just gender gaps but disparities across all dimensions of identity and opportunity.

While structured around 10 core principles and 100 recommendations, ELLEGOSSSE embodies one unified vision: choosing change through collective action. Every suggestion connects to a larger, integrated whole—emphasizing circularity, interdependence, and systemic thinking. The framework is not static; it evolves through ongoing dialogue, reflection, and real-world application, ensuring agility and relevance.

Through ELLEGOSSSE, we can bridge critical gaps—Access, Authority, Pay, Power, Voice, Safety, Education, Leadership, and more—across all intersections of discrimination and innovation. The goal is peaceful, progressive societies where diversity becomes a dividend, not a deficit.

Looking ahead, a global ELLEGOSSSE Gender Equality Index could track measurable progress. But action need not wait. With inclusive design, intentional policies, and committed engagement, each of us can ignite change now. Start something. Stay with it. See it through. In ELLEGOSSSE, everyone is an Actor, Advocate, and Accelerator of transformation.

pages.body_text:
Inner OS™ — Executive Mastery for Conscious Leaders
[hero kicker text: Mastery for Conscious Leadership]
Upgrade Your Internal Operating System. Lead from Clarity, Coherence, and Presence.
For CEOs, founders, and high-performing entrepreneurs, the greatest breakthroughs don't come from strategy alone — they come from the internal system that powers your decisions, creativity, and resilience.
Every bold decision, visionary leap, and thriving company culture originates from a leader whose inner operating system is aligned, clear, and coherent. Yet hidden stress, unresolved patterns, and subconscious friction silently erode performance, relationships, and health — even when everything seems fine externally.
THAT'S WHERE INNER OS™ BEGINS.
[CTA: Book Your Call]

What Inner OS™ Is
Inner OS™ is not coaching. It's not therapy. It is a precision-level, system-based upgrade for the high-performing mind and energy-sensitive leader.
Using my proprietary Inner OS™ methodology — integrating nervous system mastery, subconscious alignment, and energy coherence — I help leaders:
- Regulate their nervous system to sustain sharp thinking, fast recovery, and authentic presence under pressure
- Align identity, emotion, and subconscious patterns to create effortless decision-making and resilient leadership
- Access deeper clarity, intuition, and creativity without reliance on adrenaline or overwork
- Clear hidden stress, internal friction, and emotional triggers that unconsciously limit performance
The result? You lead with calm authority, decisive clarity, and authentic presence, while cultivating a company culture and personal life rooted in sustainable alignment.
[CTA: Book Your Call]

Who This Work Is For
Inner OS™ is designed for leaders who understand that real performance begins from within:
- CEOs, founders, and entrepreneurs navigating growth, transition, or high-pressure decisions
- Leaders experiencing recurring emotional patterns (overwhelm, anxiety, frustration) that impact work, relationships, or health
- Executives seeking deeper purpose, intuition, and presence despite external success
- Professionals looking for a premium performance edge grounded in alignment, not effort or adrenaline

How Inner OS™ Is Delivered
- One-on-One, Confidential Sessions: Private, bespoke, and deeply experiential
- System-Level Assessment: Map your internal operating system and uncover hidden patterns
- Precision Tools for Transformation: Advanced nervous system regulation, energy alignment, subconscious clearing, and meditative recalibration
- Integration into Daily Leadership: Practical, real-world strategies that embed Inner OS™ in decision-making, team leadership, and personal balance

The Inner OS™ Advantage
This work is for the leader who knows: What you don't resolve internally, you unconsciously carry into your company, your team, your vision, and your personal life.
With Inner OS™, you clear what's in the way — and unlock what's already within, creating:
- Effortless focus and decisive clarity
- Emotional resilience and steady presence under pressure
- Sustainable performance and conscious influence
- Alignment between personal values, intuition, and leadership impact

Leadership Starts Within.
The highest-performing leaders don't chase success. They become it from the inside out.
Inner OS™ is your blueprint for conscious leadership, transformative impact, and the kind of inner mastery that makes external success inevitable.
[CTA: Book Your Call]
